title: mentha longifolia var. asiatica
intro: Mentha longifolia var. asiatica, commonly known as Japanese mint, is a variant of the mint plant that is native to Asia. It has been traditionally used for its numerous health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, relieving digestive issues, and acting as an antioxidant to protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Japanese mint include its anti-inflammatory, anti-bacterial, and anti-fungal properties, which have been shown to be effective in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Japanese mint include menthol, menthone, and limonene, which contribute to its therapeutic effects and are responsible for its distinctive aroma and flavor.
